InCl3 was evaporated inside the reactor from a crucible held at 285~ Water and SnCl4 vapors were generated in reservoirs held in tempered baths at 25 and 10~ respectively. Water and SnCl4 were introduced to the reactor by their own vapor pressure; no bubbler systems were used. The pulsing of InCla was achieved by inert gas valving ~ while solenoid valves were used in dosing water and SnCl4 vapors. The films were grown onto 5  5 cm Corning 7059 glass substrates at 500~ The substrates were cleaned ultrasonically in ethanol and water before use. After deposition the films were cooled to -250~ under nitrogen flow before removing from the reactor. To improve their-conductivity some films were postannealed for 2 h at 500~ and 1 mbar N2 atmosphere.
